body.text: XStream Lab Homogenizer is a tabletop unit built specifically to test and scale the benefits of the NiSoX-Valve across a wide range of applications.
An innovative ergonomic geometry and design fits perfectly on laboratory desks, while ensuring results carry over reliably to industrial-scale production.
Two models are available: XStream Lab Homogenizer 1000, running up to 1000 bar at 20 l/h, and XStream Lab Homogenizer 2000, running up to 2000 bar at 9 l/h.
Operation runs through a 7" HMI touchscreen, with automatic pressure set-up and adjustment removing manual guesswork from every test run.
Easy reproduction and scalability of test results are built into the design itself, not added as an afterthought.
cGMP, CFR21, and GAMP certifications come standard, keeping the validation process straightforward for regulated environments.
A full list of options is available on both models, letting the unit adapt to specific application requirements.

body: A test result that doesn't reproduce at industrial scale is a false start, not real progress. XStream Lab Homogenizer is designed around exactly that risk, ensuring what's proven on the benchtop carries over to full production.

The NiSoX-Valve at the core of the system is the same technology behind GEA's industrial-scale homogenizers, so a lab test isn't approximating a different underlying process, it's running the actual one at smaller scale.
Automatic pressure set-up and adjustment removes operator-to-operator variability from test runs, so a result reproduced next month, or by a different technician, matches the original.
